Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Eye and Face Protection for Construction Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1926.102 and 1926.95.
  • OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910 Subpart I and 29 CFR 1926 Subpart E.
  • OSHA Respiratory Protection Safety Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.134, and Title 8, Section 5144 of the California Code of Regulations.
  • OSHA SCBA Awareness and Safe Use Training: in accordance with 29 CFR 1910.134 and 29 CFR 1926.103.
  • Cal/OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: in accordance with Title 8, California Code of Regulations Sections 3380 and 1514.
How long does PPE & Respiratory Protection Training take?
  • OSHA Eye and Face Protection for Construction Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Respiratory Protection Safety Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA SCBA Awareness and Safe Use Training: 2 hours.
  • Cal/OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: 2 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Eye and Face Protection for Construction Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Respiratory Protection Safety Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA SCBA Awareness and Safe Use Training: valid 12 months
  • Cal/OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training: valid 36 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training
  • OSHA Respiratory Protection Safety Training
  • OSHA SCBA Awareness and Safe Use Training
  • Cal/OSHA Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Training

The other course is in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
